title: What the Dungeon Keeps
tagline: gold, potions, and a pack you have written before
hints: pack.cpp is floor 15's Pack, moved out of line. Copy your own answer from there and put `Pack::` on the front of every method.
Pickups happen AFTER the move commits, inside step(), while px_/py_ are already the new square. Ask `dungeon_.tileAt(px_, py_)` and switch on what you find.
`dungeon_.setTile(px_, py_, '.')` is what stops you picking the same coin up forever. For the potion, only clear the tile when the pack actually took it.
`i` and a refused drink cost no turn: print and `continue` before any monster gets to act. A successful drink IS a turn - monsters act, and the map is drawn.
Roll exactly once per event, in the order the brief lists, or the dice will drift: gold is roll(20) + 10, a potion heals roll(8) + 8.
